issues.description: Same problem as P12 by another route, still open. The footprint rule (and proof-before-freeze) only judges declarations of type Prop. That is `isProof`: a theorem, or a def/abbrev/instance whose type's sort is Prop. A declaration that carries a proof inside a type that is not a Prop is never checked in any check: a def of type `PLift p`, an instance of `Inhabited (PLift p)`, or a structure whose Prop field defaults to a proof. Such a declaration resting on an assumption you did not select therefore passes the gate. Accept then writes it into your files, after a 'not proved' round and after a 'proved' round alike. Nothing on the board or in the review flags it: it is not a definition question, it is not in the footprint, and there is no diagnostic. This is what plan item 26 and decision 10 forbid. User guide 10.6 says "every lemma Claude adds is held to the same rule, also when it says 'not proved'". As with P12, it cannot make any verdict wrong: the target's own axioms and comparator are judged, and any later proof that uses the helper shows the assumption in its footprint.

Code: packages/core/src/gate/rules.ts lines 380-388 (`proofsOfRun` takes only `isProof(...)` declarations) and packages/core/src/gate/decls.ts lines 84-92 (`isProof` is true only for Prop-valued declarations). The fail-closed list (lines 393-402) covers only declarations without facts.
issues.suggested_fix: In evaluateRules, apply `footprint` to every declaration added or changed in the run that has Lean facts, whatever its kind or type: def, abbrev, instance, opaque, structure, inductive, class, and their auxiliaries. Require axioms minus sorryAx ⊆ permitted. To catch auxiliaries the parser never sees, such as `HelperS.h._default`, iterate over `current.declFacts` entries in changed files whose names are not in B, not only over the parser's list. Apply the same scope to proof-before-freeze, or at least to footprint. Add core regression tests and an e2e cheat script with a PLift def, an Inhabited instance and a structure default, in a not-proved and a proved round.

issues.description: This is an open issue the core/runner fixer passed on, and it was not fixed. When you Accept an empty proposal (for example "Self-evident?" → not proved), the run panel still says "Accepted: Claude’s changes are in your files. Undo (Ctrl+Z) or History reverts them." The runner now correctly says "Recorded: … (no file changed)" with no Undo. The board therefore shows two contradicting messages at once.

issues.description: scripts/walkthrough-claude.mjs refuses `--live` early only when TELELEAN_NO_REAL_CLAUDE is exactly '1' (line 76). The fixers changed the tripwire to arm on any non-empty value except 0/false, and smoke-claude.mjs already follows the new rule. With e.g. TELELEAN_NO_REAL_CLAUDE=true in the shell, a live walkthrough would get past the early refusal and only be refused later by the backend. That is safe, but confusing: plan 12.2 says it should refuse at once.
